subject: Third-party evidence delivery for marketplace readiness
messages:
From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@stratuscloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing — security artifacts request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our Marketplace onboarding team has a checklist for co-sell readiness and they're asking for a bundle of security/compliance artifacts we need to upload: SOC2 Type II report, an independent pen-test attestation/letter, and an executed DPA. GCP also asks for an "evidence index" that maps each artifact to the marketplace question.

Can you confirm whether you can provide the PDF copies (redacted where necessary) and an indexed spreadsheet by next Thursday (12/10)? We may need a signed pen-test letter (vendor-signed) for our legal review.

Also copying GCP marketplace ops in case they prefer different formats.

Best,
Amir
Amir Khan
Head of Cloud Partnerships
StratusCloud Systems
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@stratuscloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — security artifacts request

Hi Amir —

Thanks for the list and the deadline. We'll assemble a consolidated package and deliver the artifacts you called out. Quick notes:

- SOC2 Type II: we have the 2026 report and can provide a redacted PDF.
- Pen-test: we commissioned a third-party pentest in Q3; we have the executive letter from the vendor but need to confirm whether we can share the full findings (we typically provide the letter + remediation attestations).
- DPA: we do have an executed DPA template; I'll attach the executed copy for Stratus to the package.
- Evidence index: Marissa will draft the mapping spreadsheet (evidence_index_2026-12-07.xlsx) that maps each artifact to the marketplace control/question.

Marissa / Aditya — can one of you validate the pen-test sharing constraints and confirm the vendor-signed letter? Also, please add the DocuSign link for the DPA in the package. I want to send the assembled bundle to Amir and GCP by EOD Wed (12/8).

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — security artifacts request (internal)

Hannah — quick internal status: attaching the current artifacts and a short index draft.

Attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (redacted)
- pen-test-letter_3rdparty-2026.pdf (vendor-signed executive attestation)
- DPA-executed_Redwood-v2.pdf (executed copy with minor redactions)
- evidence_index_2026-12-07.xlsx (mapping sheet)

Notes / outstanding items:
1) The pen-test vendor provided an executive attestation letter (signed) — it does not include raw findings. Legal has confirmed this is usually acceptable for marketplace intake, but Stratus can request additional evidence under an NDA.
2) GCP specifically wants the pen-test scope and the statement of remediation for any critical findings; I added a one-paragraph remediation summary into the evidence index.
3) DPA: executed copy is included, but if Stratus requests a counter-signed DocuSign URL, we should prepare that.
4) I updated the index to reference the relevant marketplace control IDs for AWS/GCP — fields are highlighted.

If this looks good I can assemble the final zip and upload to Drive, then ping HubSpot with the doc links.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Khan <amir.khan@stratuscloud.com>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Ops <gcp-marketplace-ops@google.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — security artifacts request

Amir —

Attached is the evidence bundle for StratusCloud's marketplace onboarding. Summary of what's included:

- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf — SOC2 Type II report (redacted cover + testing summary).
- pen-test-letter_3rdparty-2026.pdf — vendor-signed executive attestation and scope summary.
- DPA-executed_Redwood-v2.pdf — executed DPA copy.
- evidence_index_2026-12-07.xlsx — index mapping each artifact to AWS/GCP control IDs and a short remediation summary for the pen-test.

Uploads & links:
- Evidence folder (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcExampleEvidenceFolder
- HubSpot deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4821
- DocuSign (if you require a counter-signed DPA URL): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example/DocuSign-STR-4821

If GCP Marketplace Ops needs a different file format or additional scope detail for the pen-test, let us know and we can coordinate with the vendor under an NDA. Otherwise, feel free to use the attached artifacts for the marketplace intake.

Next steps:
- Amir — please confirm receipt and whether the package satisfies StratusCloud's legal intake.
- If you want the vendor to share further details, we can route an NDA and arrange the vendor-to-vendor transfer.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf; pen-test-letter_3rdparty-2026.pdf; DPA-executed_Redwood-v2.pdf; evidence_index_2026-12-07.xlsx
